rows.label: The Deadlock Protocol
rows.note: unlocks Treasurers, Granum Crowns and the Granum Void

conditions: Without this quest, Treasurers spawn but drop nothing.
The main blueprint is Jackal-only; it is not sold in the Market.
bonuses: Fossa is also a Granum Crown node; linger 2-5 minutes after the Jackal to bank a Normal Crown for a Receiver run.

groups.activity: kill the Treasurer, then Granum Void Rotation C
conditions: Only Rotation C (75 kills solo, +25 per extra squad member) drops parts; 25 and 50 kills pay only credits, Endo and Void Traces.
The Treasurer spawns 2-5 minutes into a non-endless mission and runs if you're slow; the Crown is consumed on interaction, so a failed run costs a Treasurer kill.

groups.activity: kill the Treasurer, then Extended Granum Void Rotation C
conditions: Enemy level 16-30 sets the Exemplar crown tier; Laomedeia or Triton, Neptune also work.

groups.activity: kill the Treasurer, then Nightmare Granum Void Rotation C
conditions: Enemy level 30+ sets the Zenith crown tier: Acheron or Cypress, Pluto, any Steel Path mission, or any Sister mission also qualify.

disclosures.title: spawn manipulation
disclosures.body: Specters spawn only in fixed spots within a radius around you. Bullet-jump onto a tall rock at the map edge and stay there; they pile up at its base as fast as you kill them. One player reports a full Nightmare Rotation C clear in about 30 seconds this way, no triangle collecting needed.

disclosures.title: frames that trivialize it
disclosures.body: Mesa's Peacemaker from high ground is the default pick, though specter particles can clog the spawn cap. Octavia with Mallet (plus the second-mallet augment) is called more reliable by some. Revenant's Danse Macabre, Volt's Discharge and Protea's turret also clear it. A 0-forma Xoris (heavy-attack throw, detonate mid-air) works on any frame and is the cheapest reliable method; don't sell it.
